text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from visiting a hotel on business, I bumped into Satono Diamond, who seemed to be quite busy.
choice_data_list: You seem awfully busy.
You seem awfully busy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm swamped with preparations for the "betrothal exchange."
choice_data_list: "Betrothal exchange"?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am planning a get-together for everyone from the merging video production company and simulator company!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If the merger commemorative event is the "wedding," then the introductory meeting has to be the "betrothal exchange," right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ I absolutely have to make it a great ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Well then, I still have plenty of preparations left, so if you'll excuse me—
choice_data_list: Are you doing this alone?
Are you doing this alone?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course I'm not doing it all alone! But since I'm the one who proposed it, I have to work the hardest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She says that, but it still looks like quite a handful. Since I don't have any plans afterwards—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I head toward the banquet hall venue together with Satono Diamond. However...

text_block_list.name: Employees
text_block_list.text:
—Even if they suddenly tell us we're merging...
—Even if we're both in the video industry, what we do is completely different.
—Will our way of doing things even fly over there?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Actually, partly influenced by the reactions on social media, discontent has been spreading among the employees of both sides.
choice_data_list: Is this... going to be okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course, we cannot leave it like this. That is why today exists. Now, let's change this atmosphere—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: With the Dia-style "Betrothal Ceremony"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —We shall now commence the "Betrothal Ritual" for both companies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Today, as betrothal gifts, both parties have prepared their flagship products.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We will have this person test the products and demonstrate each of their unique features.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At her signal, I put on the VR headset and stepped onto the stage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now then, everyone, please direct your attention to the screen set up over there.

text_block_list.name: Ghost
text_block_list.text: UBOOOAAAAHHH!!
choice_data_list: Whoaaaaaaa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My, what immense intensity! As expected of a best-selling VR horror title!

text_block_list.name: Simulator Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: ...As horror goes, it's pretty standard. But... the reactions are strangely natural...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's almost as if the ghost is waiting for Trainer-san to drop their guard before scaring them.

text_block_list.name: Video Production Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: It accurately tracks the viewer's gaze and movements, so it adjusts the ghost's spawn point and timing specifically for that person.

text_block_list.name: Simulator Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: Adjusting to the target's lapses...? ...Hmph. If that's functioning, the foundational tracking precision must be—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: This forestry simulator here is actually adopted in real training courses!
choice_data_list: The chainsaw feels totally real!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can even feel the exact amount of force applied! How does this work?

text_block_list.name: Simulator Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: The feedback adjusts depending on RPM and load. It even replicates changes in output.

text_block_list.name: Video Production Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: ...I see. That's why the "tactile sense of operation" never cuts out. This feels great.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah! Amazing, simply amazing! It really feels like soaring through the sky!

text_block_list.name: Simulator Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: ...Um. How does that behavior work?

text_block_list.name: Video Production Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: Ah, as for that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Realizing each other's technical prowess, the employees spontaneously begin conversing. Before long—

text_block_list.name: Video Production Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: —If we combined that staging from earlier with this level of reproducibility, it would make for an intensely immersive experience.

text_block_list.name: Simulator Co. Executive
text_block_list.text: Yeah, absolutely. ...Honestly, we were so fixated on our own ways that we didn't even try to look at your tech...
choice_data_list: The mood is completely different from earlier.
The mood is completely different from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Precisely because they have different strengths. I believe combining them will create even greater value.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I am truly glad to see them embracing it so positively!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: After all, this merger is a "union" meant to build a brand new future!
choice_data_list: I hope it becomes a great company!
I hope it becomes a great company!
Did you plan this approach from the very start?
Did you plan this approach from the very start?
I wonder what kind of "wedding" it will turn out to be.
I wonder what kind of "wedding" it will turn out to be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: After all, this merger is a "union" meant to build a brand new future!
choice_data_list: I hope it becomes a great company!
I hope it becomes a great company!
Did you plan this approach from the very start?
Did you plan this approach from the very start?
I wonder what kind of "wedding" it will turn out to be.
I wonder what kind of "wedding" it will turn out to be.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. It definitely will♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: A formidable rival company that won't lose even to the Satono Group—without a doubt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Satono Diamond patted her chest with full confidence.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Rather than from the start... it was the result of continuously thinking about how to convey it properly.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Once I'm convinced something will work out, I simply can't resist giving it shape♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Satono Diamond let out a somewhat mischievous chuckle.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I am looking forward to it as well!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still, I believe it will turn out to be a wonderful ceremony... No, I will definitely make it a wonderful ceremony!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying so, Satono Diamond looked at me with an earnest gaze.
